reviews.title: Account Deleted??
reviews.text:
I have been playing this since it came out. I’ve introduced other players! I took a break for about a year, all my work gone! No Fb, email, or Apple accounts linked to me, it says zero pictures completed, all the stones I’ve earned, everything gone! I will never purchase anything cash through them! I do not recommend any game that suddenly deletes YEARS of progress irretrievably! And on top of that, no customer support concerning this issue! They just never bothered to answer.

Also, this game has changed so much! And not for the better! The amount of ads (if you don’t subscribe), is ludicrous! You’re MOLESTED by ads at the bottom of the screen, every 5 minutes while coloring, before you start a picture, when you finish a picture! Most coloring apps have commercials before & after the picture. Dazzly also has them frequently while you’re coloring a picture. How are they mismanaging things so badly that they need SO MANY ads?? And they expect a monthly payment comparable in price to things like Netflix! How much money do these games think people have to waste???

reviews.title: Ad Insanity
reviews.text: Wish I could give this game more stars.  It’s visually beautiful.  The color, the sparkle, the coloring designs are all lovely.  There are several designs that are in-game purchases but there are plenty of free ones to choose from.  However, the cons far outweigh the pros.  The most minor being it’s processor intensive and heats up my phone, drains the battery fast, and freezes the game.  The ads are the real problem though. There are a ton.  Want me to watch a full ad before I start a new design?  Sure, no problem.  But an ad after I complete every other gem color?  That’s a bit much and breaks the relaxing flow of the game (the ads last forever too).  Is there an ad free option? Yes, but it’s a subscription for $10 a week.  You heard me.  A WEEK!  Maybe that’s fine for some, but for me that’s an insanity-level money grab.  That’s why this game gets 2 stars and I’ll be deleting it.  Too bad because I like it, but they’ve made it really unpleasant to play with the ads.

reviews.title: Fantastic Game But Too Many Ads & Expensive
reviews.text:
I am devastated to be giving this app only 1 star but here are my reasons why:

A) The app is great but you only get 3 days free trial.

B) Once the trial expires they expect you to pay £9.99 A WEEK! That’s £40 A MONTH! It’s absolute daylight robbery, I would expect the pictures to be made with the real gems and posted to me for that price. I understand that charging is a way to keep the app great, but not even some of the most popular games on the App Store charge anywhere near that.

C) Once the trial ends, you are then hit with the adds to continue playing. These adds are 60 odd seconds a go, and you can’t even finish a picture without more popping up throughout.

Such a great, relaxing game, ruined by greed. Let me know if your pricing becomes more realistic and I will re-download.

reviews.title: Disappointed after coming back
reviews.text:
I truly do love this app and how it is so calming and therapeutic. What I abhor is the obvious money grab that it’s become. The subscription options are very unaffordable and outlandish; I understand that the whole design of the app is a bit more precise and refined than the usual color by numbers apps; but charging  $10 per week, $24 per month and $100 for a whole year is insane. That’s outrageous when you could use that same money for a literal bill payment or for a language app. You’d get far more bang with your buck with a language app. 

I’ve noticed other reviewers bring up the subscription options issue before and the usual replies from the developer, although worded professionally, come across as saying “we’re sorry you’re too poor, we have options for the poor people, we say we’ll look into it but we’re not going to do anything to change Okie byyyyeee.”

The last straw for me was when I noticed that I can no longer freely tap a gem and it immediately zooms in to where I missed one in the picture. It counts as a “hint” , and now there’s limited hints. Now I have to watch ads, even when subscribed, in order to get more hints. It’s sad that these things have pushed me away from using an otherwise well-made and enjoyable app. I hope these things get fixed in the future.

reviews.title: Can not recover account
reviews.text: I have paid for a dazzly account for my daughter for a year. She never actually created an account to log into. The app was accidentally deleted. All of her gems and hundreds of dazzly patterns she completed were just gone in an instant. I contacted Geode and they told me to log in. I explained the situation. If I have been paying $10 a week, there should be an account associated with my name or phone number. Then I realized that there is a problem with having an account to log into. If you log out, all progress is lost. Everything. I tested it to be sure her progress would be saved and logging out deletes everything. So if she accidentally logs out, she’s lost it all again. I have contacted Geode several times about recovering the lost account with the purchaser ID and my name and number and have been completely ignored since the first email. Do not pay for this app. I now have a broken hearted little girl. She loved playing dazzly and collecting her gems every day and lost everything.
